note: whatsnew-390: MLB and NHL My Career: the season is as long as the real one. In NHL My Career a season is 84 games now, the way the league plays it from 2026-27, and a throwback career goes through the real short years: 48 games in 2012-13, 56 in 2020-21, and the 68 to 71 a club had played when 2019-20 stopped. In MLB My Career the 2020 season is 60 games, and a club that really finished a game short or played a 163rd does the same in your career, the 2026 Orioles and Yankees on 161 included. October follows the year too: no wild card round before 2012, one Wild Card Game from 2012 to 2019 and in 2021, and from 2022 a best of three, five, seven and seven, so losing the Wild Card Series is two or three games and never five. Awards in a short season are judged like a full one, and a hitter's postseason line adds up now (4 for 16 reads .250). Seasons you already played stay exactly as they were.
